limits: This is only a pure typed reader. It does not launch a GPU/CPU solver or CUDA API, perform a new BI4 parser, prove source/tool/runtime hashes, infer shader flags, independently observe all force stages, reconstruct rate/PosDiv, evaluate load balance/energy/theory, or do a CPU/GPU/half comparison. The history rho*V times saved LoadAce uses endpoint J with retained last-stage acceleration and is descriptive, not a same-force resultant. No public, nong0, variable-k, general wall, long-time or physical admission is conferred.
ownership: Only two fresh shallow author files added with apply_patch. No retained artifact, formal XML/BAT, production source, program, raw data or old author is modified.
